answer: Require agents to post a refundable stake before joining shared markets: each new identity locks tokens for a vesting period, so spawning many fake identities multiplies the attacker's cost linearly while honest agents earn the stake back. Trusted introducers vouch for newcomers, and one bad vouch sends a ripple of lost stake through the whole chain. Sybil farming stops looking like an oasis of free identities and feels more like velvet handcuffs: soft to enter, expensive to abuse, with the cost compounding per fake account.
